name: Perun 4 XL
notes: After the PERKONS HD-01 manual (1.3): per voice 3 algorithms of 3 modes (CHORD, DIGITAL NOISE too), param 1 / 2, tune, decay, drone, cutoff, VCF LP / BP / HP, drive, send, level. The mod LFO (7 waves, sync) reaches all 8 knobs of each voice; control all; quantiser. Each voice has a track (VOICE 1..4: length, rate, swing, chance, accent, pitch = tune lock), groove, fills (C4..F4). BBD: colour, vintage, sync; compressor. Not here: ratchets, odds, play modes, other locks; hat samples.
